Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment uses RIME, which is an affinity purification (AP-MS) method to study the ERα interactome. Acquisition is DDA based on the '10 most intense fragments' selection logic.

scope: Our lab has previously developed a method termed RIME (Rapid Immunoprecipitation of Endogenous Proteins) for the study of protein complexes using mass spectrometry.
For RIME, the antibody-bound beads incubated with the chromatin samples were washed 10 times with RIPA buffer and twice with 100mM AMBIC (ammonium bicarbonate) prior to mass spectrometry analysis.
A 10µL trypsin solution (15ng/ul) (Pierce) prepared in 100mM AMBIC was added to the beads followed by overnight incubation at 37°C.
subcellular_fraction: In order to enrich for the nuclear fraction, pellets were resuspended in Lysis Buffer 1 (50mM Hepes–KOH, pH 7.5, 140mM NaCl, 1mM EDTA, 10% Glycerol, 0.5% NP-40/Igepal CA-630, 0.25% Triton X-100) and rotated for 10 minutes, at 4°C.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The proteomics material was derived from RIME (Rapid Immunoprecipitation of Endogenous Proteins), which involves antibody-based capture of the ERα complex from a nuclear-enriched fraction.

The antibodies are treated as the agents of the comparison.
